thread.title: Close Update: Dow Dips 100 Points as Wall Street Braces for Trade Announcement

author: MT Newswires
title: Close Update: Dow Dips 100 Points as Wall Street Braces for Trade Announcement
text:
Shutterstock photo The Dow Jones Industrial Average lost nearly 100 points late Monday when selling erupted into the close as investors braced for an announcement from President Donald Trump concerning $200 billion in tariffs on imported Chinese goods. Weighed down by component stocks Apple ( AAPL ), Boeing ( BA ) and McDonald's ( MCD ) and worries that China will retaliate to trade restrictions, the blue chip index closed lower for the first time in five days.
Plagued by the escalating trade war between the US and China, stocks started the week on the back foot with FAANG and consumer cyclical stocks taking the brunt as investors rotated into safe haven and defensive sectors.
Economic data also contributed to the poor price action Monday after the Empire State manufacturing index fell to 19.0 in September, its lowest level in five months and below the estimated 23.0.
The defensive tone across Wall Street was exacerbated by selling pressure on the technology sector, led by Amazon ( AMZN ) and Apple ( AAPL ) following reports of an internal investigation into data leaks by employees, and sluggish sales of the iPhone XS and Max, respectively.
While NEC Director Larry Kudlow tried to mitigate trade tensions on Wall Street, the likelihood for the White House to slap Chinese imports with 10%-25% this week kept the pressure on trade sensitive stocks in the semiconductor, materials and machinery sectors.
